latestVersion.changelog:
Dreaming Guard Pro 1.0.0 – Initial release.

- Provides smart, zero-dependency protection against OpenClaw dreaming context overflow and memory issues.
- Features real-time growth monitoring, three-tiered archiving/compression, process memory protection, and automated crash self-recovery.
- Generates periodic health reports in multiple formats (text, json, markdown).
- Highly configurable with environment variable overrides and modular API design.
- Usable as a ClawHub Skill, a Node.js module, or as standalone components.
